name: Violeta Artificial
source:
What remains of you when algorithms decide for you?

Step into the role of Violeta, an influencer who builds her life around social media in search of validation. Between filters, trends, and endless comments, her sense of self begins to fracture—until she no longer knows who she is beyond the screen.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4547120/Artificial_Violet/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
当算法为你做决定时，你还剩下什么？

扮演维奥莱塔（Violeta）的角色，她是一位有影响力的人，她的生活围绕社交媒体寻求认可。在过滤器、趋势和无休止的评论之间，她的自我意识开始破裂——直到她不再知道屏幕之外的自己是谁。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4547120/Artificial_Violet/]Steam[/url]]
